instruction: Open the Huggingface daily papers page for March 1, 2024 in Chrome.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly reads the active Chrome tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is exactly the state needed to verify that the correct page was opened.
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' applies regex pattern matching on the URL, which is logically correct for this type of verification.
The expected regex pattern 'huggingface\.co/papers.*2024-03-01' correctly matches the target URL 'https://huggingface.co/papers?date=2024-03-01', covering both the required path and date.
Parameter handling is correct: when expected.type='rule', the framework passes the rules dict directly, and the metric accesses rules['expected'] — no parameter handling bugs.
Full instruction coverage: both the domain/path (huggingface.co/papers) and the specific date (2024-03-01) are verified by the regex.
Good negative control resistance: the initial state opens 'https://huggingface.co/' which does NOT match the pattern, so a do-nothing agent will not pass.
No postconfig needed since the accessibility tree reads live browser state at evaluation time.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent scrolled through the open LibreOffice Writer doc to read the format of two recorded papers, then switched to Chrome and typed https://huggingface.co/papers?date=2024-03-01 in the address bar. The HuggingFace page repeatedly failed to load; the agent spent all remaining turns retrying and ultimately hit the 50-step limit without writing any new papers.
metadata.capability_extraction: Agent can scroll through LibreOffice Writer, read document structure, switch to Chrome, and type URLs into the address bar.
metadata.failure_analysis: HuggingFace page failed to load (network timeout/restriction in the VM) around step 10-15. Agent kept retrying navigation instead of finding an alternative approach, exhausting all 50 turns.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplifies the original task to just the browser navigation sub-goal that was demonstrated in the reliable prefix (steps 7-9). Evaluator uses regex pattern matching on the URL in the address bar, which succeeds even if the page has a network error, as long as the agent correctly typed and submitted the URL.
metadata.explanation: Agent must navigate Chrome to https://huggingface.co/papers?date=2024-03-01. Evaluator reads the active tab URL from the accessibility tree (no page reload) and applies regex matching to confirm the URL contains 'huggingface.co/papers' and '2024-03-01'.
